lines.label: What it holds

source.publisher: Federaal Agentschap voor Geneesmiddelen en Gezondheidsproducten

lines.value: All human and veterinary medicines with a valid marketing authorisation, registration, parallel import authorisation or temporary authorisation for use in Belgium, plus suspended or revoked ones in a separate section.

lines.label: Authorisation

source.publisher: Federaal Agentschap voor Geneesmiddelen en Gezondheidsproducten

lines.value: A marketing authorisation is an official document issued by the Belgian Minister of Public Health or the European Commission after assessment of a medicine's safety, efficacy and quality.

source.publisher: Federaal Agentschap voor Geneesmiddelen en Gezondheidsproducten

lines.label: Rule

source.publisher: Federaal Agentschap voor Geneesmiddelen en Gezondheidsproducten

lines.value: A unique identification number for each packaging form of products available in retail pharmacies, assigned by the national general pharmaceutical association at the request of the responsible company, only for products commercially available in Belgium.
